methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $93M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 1 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 12 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 21.5x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

private.name: SambaNova Systems

data.narrative:
Cognichip is a Series A semiconductor company founded by Faraj Aalaei that has raised $93M to date. The valuation universe for Chips & Semiconductors comprises 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including SambaNova Systems, Cerebras, and Credo Semiconductor.

Only one valuation method is applicable to this analysis. Stage-progression anchors to the $93M in total capital raised and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the next funding stage, yielding $186M. Peer-median analysis cannot be applied due to insufficient narrow-stage peers—while 12 same-sector companies exist, the filtered set yielded fewer than 3 datapoints. Public-comp anchoring using the 21.5x median P/S multiple across semiconductor peers is not applicable because Cognichip's revenue is not disclosed, a common limitation for private companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $158M to $214M, with a median point of $186M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression method. Material uncertainties include the absence of revenue data (precluding P/S anchoring), limited comparable precedent at precisely this stage and tier, and the early-stage commercial status of frontier semiconductor ventures. The valuation should be revisited upon revenue disclosure or emergence of additional narrow-peer transactions.
